explain.ta: எதிர்மறை அல்லது எதிர்பாராத விளைவுகளை வெளிப்படுத்த நாம் ALTHOUGH, HOWEVER, DESPITE போன்ற connectors பயன்படுத்துகிறோம். 'ALTHOUGH' ஒரு வாக்கியத்தில் எதிர்மறையை காட்டுகிறது (Although it rained, we went out - மழை பெய்தாலும், நாங்கள் வெளியே சென்றோம்). 'HOWEVER' இரண்டு தனி வாக்கியங்களை இணைக்கிறது (It rained. However, we went out - மழை பெய்தது. இருப்பினும், நாங்கள் வெளியே சென்றோம்). 'DESPITE' noun அல்லது -ing வடிவத்துடன் பயன்படுத்தப்படுகிறது (Despite the rain, we went out).
explain.en: We use contrast connectors like ALTHOUGH, HOWEVER, DESPITE to show unexpected or contrasting results. 'ALTHOUGH' introduces contrast within one sentence (Although it rained, we went out). 'HOWEVER' connects two separate sentences (It rained. However, we went out). 'DESPITE' is followed by a noun or -ing form (Despite the rain, we went out). These connectors make your communication more sophisticated and natural.

examples: Although I was tired, I continued working.
She passed although she didn't study much.
Although it's expensive, I'll buy it.
I was tired. However, I continued working.
She didn't study much. However, she passed.
It's expensive. However, I'll buy it.
Despite being tired, I continued working.
Despite the price, I'll buy it.
